meta.title: A tie at the lowest price: L1 shows that price, whichever vendor
gaps: The available read-back fields do not expose the tie price or line totals, so the plan only checks that an L1/best-bidder result is present.
warnings: verify 1: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is not empty.
